description: Claude Code plugin that generates individualized knowledge systems from conversation. You describe how you think and work, have a conversation and get a complete second brain as markdown files you own.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin that generates a personalized markdown-based second brain (knowledge system) from a conversation about how you think and work.
summary.what_it_does: The plugin runs a conversational setup (/arscontexta:setup) that asks a few questions about your domain, then derives and generates a complete knowledge system: folder structure, context files, processing pipeline, hooks, navigation maps (Maps of Content), and note templates with schema blocks. The output is plain markdown files connected by wiki links, split into three spaces (self/, notes/, ops/). Generated commands include /reduce, /reflect, /reweave, /verify, and /ralph, which runs queue-based processing with a fresh subagent per phase. Four hooks enforce schema on writes, auto-commit to git, orient sessions, and capture session state. A methodology/ directory holds 249 research claims that the README says back the configuration choices, queryable via /arscontexta:ask. Optional qmd integration adds semantic search.
use_cases: build a personal second brain from markdown notes
set up an agent-maintained knowledge base for research
turn source material into atomic linked notes
automate note linking and maintaining older notes
organize a Claude Code workflow around a persistent vault
create a journaling or life-management note system with an AI agent
how_to_run: Answer 2-4 questions about your domain (about 20 minutes)
Restart Claude Code again to activate generated hooks and skills
notable: Derives the system from conversation rather than applying fixed templates, with each choice tied to cited research claims
Generates per-domain folder structure, templates with _schema blocks, and a user manual
/ralph runs each pipeline phase in a fresh subagent context to keep LLM attention sharp
Hooks validate schema on every note write and auto-commit changes to git
Plain markdown vault with no database or cloud dependency
caveats: Setup is token-intensive and takes about 20 minutes; the README calls it a one-time investment
Requires Claude Code v1.0.33+, plus tree and ripgrep installed
Multi-agent processing is listed as in progress on the roadmap
keywords: keep notes for my ai agent
connect old notes with new ideas
